now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
now.text: Kora learns that Nathaniel killed her mother, Jiaying, and begins to doubt him. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and has her locked up.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Learns Nathaniel killed Jiaying and turns on him.

proposed.text: Kora confronts Nathaniel about killing her mother, Jiaying, but he wins her back with lies about her. When she lets Daisy go, he shoots her and has her locked up.

changes.evidence: Kora learns Nathaniel killed Jiaying in S7#11 ('Brand New Day'), when May shows her Jiaying's body and tells her. In S7#12 ('The End Is at Hand') she questions him about it, he lies that Jiaying called her a mistake and wins her back; later she lets Daisy go and he shoots her and has her locked up.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
now.text: Nathaniel chafes when Sibyl orders him to be patient and leave Quake to her Hunters.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Chronicom leader Nathaniel works with.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A rogue Malick heir Sibyl keeps on a short leash.

proposed.text: Nathaniel argues with Sibyl to let him kill the agents, but she orders him not to interfere so Daisy can reach Simmons. He sends Kora after Daisy anyway.

changes.evidence: In S7#12 Sibyl tells Malick not to interfere because Daisy reuniting with Simmons raises the odds of learning Fitz's location; she does not tell him to leave Quake to her Hunters. An impatient Malick has Kora confront Daisy.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
now.text: After years apart from the team, Fitz reunites with May and the others in 1983 and helps them finish their mission against the Chronicoms.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Fitz reunites with in 1983 to finish the mission.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who rejoins May in 1983 against the Chronicoms.

proposed.text: After years apart from the team, Fitz comes through a portal and reunites with May and the others in 1983.

changes.evidence: In S7#12 Fitz only arrives at the end, dropping through the Quantum Realm portal at the speakeasy. Helping finish the mission against the Chronicoms happens in S7#13 ('What We're Fighting For'), which has no stage for this pair.
